digest.component_or_area: opt-in verify gates (gate_enabled, plan-review gate, completion gate)
propositions: On an unreadable or malformed rebar.toml, gate_enabled must raise ConfigError (chained from the parse fault, with message naming the gate label, ticket ID, and underlying error) instead of silently returning GateState.UNREADABLE and failing open

With a malformed config, gated operations (claim, close) must fail loudly to the operator before entering the write lock or performing work, leaving the ticket in its prior state (open or in_progress)
GateState.UNREADABLE is removed as it becomes unreachable; gate resolution retains only ENABLED/DISABLED states and bool compatibility for existing test monkeypatches
The CLI boundary in main() gains an except ConfigError handler to render config faults as clean Error: messages to stderr with exit 1, not tracebacks
Documentation (plan-review-gate.md, config.md, llm-framework.md) is updated to reflect the new contract: unreadable config raises error (never silent skip, never fake disabled)
The close-path error must be raised BEFORE the write lock; the no-work-under-lock property is preserved by the pre-lock check raising ConfigError before transition_core takes the write lock
